step_metadata.name: Functional Architecture Finalization
step_metadata.description: Package functional architecture deliverables and prepare for next phase or final delivery

metrics: Context consumption estimate (if AI workflow) (e.g., 45k tokens average path)
next_steps: OPTION A: Continue to service architecture (allocate functions to services)
OPTION B: Stop here (deliver functional architecture to stakeholders)

service_organization_analysis.description: Analyze functional architecture to recommend service organization strategy BEFORE functional allocation
service_organization_analysis.when_to_run: After user chooses Option A (continue to service architecture), BEFORE allocation

analysis.method: Count functions with coordination keywords (lock, synchronize, queue, coordinate, state, transaction)

analysis_2.method: Map functional flows to domains, count cross-domain flows

analysis_3.method: Classify functions as CRUD (create, read, update, delete patterns) vs workflow (multi-step, coordination-heavy)

workflow_based.benefit: Keeps coordination logic local, workflows self-contained

domain_based.benefit: Clear domain boundaries, aligns with business domains

hybrid.benefit: Best of both - workflow services for complex flows, domain services for shared resources

user_prompt.template:
Based on functional architecture analysis:
- Coordination Complexity: {complexity} ({count} coordination points)
- Workflow Span: {span} ({percent}% cross-domain)
- Operations: {ops_type} ({crud_percent}% CRUD, {workflow_percent}% workflows)

**Recommendation: {strategy}**
{rationale}

Would you like to:
1. Accept {strategy} (recommended)
2. Use domain-based instead
3. Use workflow-based instead
4. Use hybrid approach

user_decision_point.mandatory: YES - User MUST decide whether to continue or stop
user_decision_point.question: Do you want to continue to service architecture (allocate functions to services) or stop here (architecture-only deliverables)?

option_a.pre_step: Run service_organization_analysis FIRST to recommend strategy
option_a.benefit: Complete system implementation from functional architecture through to runnable code

option_b.outcome: Workflow complete - deliver functional architecture package to stakeholders
option_b.benefit: Focus on functional design and validation without committing to implementation
use_cases: Request for proposal (RFP) response - show functional design
Feasibility study - validate functional approach before implementation
Stakeholder alignment - get sign-off on functional architecture before building
Outsourcing - provide functional specs to implementation team
